definition_of_stable: Stable = the version the publisher's own flags point to as current: PyPI info.version (not yanked, not a pre/dev release) and GitHub 'latest' release (not prerelease, not draft). Not independent corroboration: all three sources are published by the project or its package host.

pypi.summary: A simple framework for building complex web applications.
pypi.description_first_text:
Flask

Flask is a lightweight WSGI web application framework. It is designed
to make getting started quick and easy, with the ability to scale up to
complex applications. It began as a simple wrapper

github_release.body:
This is the Flask 3.1.3 security fix release, which fixes a security issue but does not otherwise change behavior and should not result in breaking changes compared to the latest feature release.

PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/Flask/3.1.3/
Changes: https://flask.palletsprojects.com/page/changes/#version-3-1-3

- The session is marked as accessed for operations that only access the keys but not the values, such as `in` and `len`. [GHSA-68rp-wp8r-4726](https://github.com/pallets/flask/security/advisories/GHSA-68rp-wp8r-4726)

changelog.section_text: - The session is marked as accessed for operations that only access the keys but not the values, such as ``in`` and ``len``. :ghsa:`68rp-wp8r-4726`
